import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.cpp_extension import load_inline


# Kernel source for matmul
matmul_kernel_source = """
#include <torch/extension.h>
#include <cuda_runtime.h>

__global__ void matmul_kernel(const float* A, const float* B, float* C, int M, int K, int N) {
    int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (idx < M * N) {
        int i = idx / N;
        int j = idx % N;
        float sum = 0.0f;
        for (int k = 0; k < K; ++k) {
            sum += A[i*K + k] * B[k*N + j];
        }
        C[idx] = sum;
    }
}

torch::Tensor matmul_cuda(torch::Tensor a, torch::Tensor b) {
    auto A_shape = a.shape();
    auto B_shape = b.shape();

    int M = A_shape[0];
    int K = A_shape[1]; // columns of A
    int N = B_shape[1]; // rows of B (since B is (K,N))

    auto out = torch::zeros_like(a);

    const int BLOCK_SIZE = 256;
    const int NUM_BLOCKS = (M * N + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / BLOCK_SIZE;

    matmul_kernel<<<NUM_BLOCKS, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(
        a.data_ptr<float>(), b.data_ptr<float()>, out.data_ptr<float()>, M, K, N
    );
